attrs.evidence: spec_vectors.mjs v0.3.0 composes docs/spec/proof-wire/vectors/public/cas/ and never reads a locally generated bundle -- verified by perturbing the local producer output and observing the gate stay green. live_dag.mjs asserts that the local leaves verify, the local DAG verifies, all references resolve in the local store, and all 5 semantic identities equal the frozen corpus (a claim identity does not bind provenance, so a local one that moved WOULD be a defect), and reports the complete root as matching-or-differing without asserting either. Gate `gov-nest`.
attrs.statement: A PROTOCOL CONFORMANCE ORACLE MUST NOT DEPEND ON THE ENVIRONMENT THAT FROZE IT. A conformance gate whose candidate is regenerated by the LOCAL producer compares complete artifact identities that legitimately bind execution provenance -- the identity of the binary that produced them -- so it silently asks *does this machine recreate the producer bytes of the machine that issued this revision* while claiming to ask *does this implementation implement the protocol*. Measured: perturbing execution_provenance.executable_artifact_id on 128 sides left every SEMANTIC identity intact and the proof VERIFIED, moved the leaf artifact_root, propagated through every reference and ancestor root exactly as artifact-version identity is designed to, and produced 17 conformance disagreements. THE REPAIR IS IN THE TEST PLANE AND NOT IN THE IDENTITY: artifact_root MUST keep binding provenance. Portable conformance consumes the FROZEN leaf fixtures AS FIXTURES -- read, parsed, composed, with no producer launched -- and a SEPARATE gate exercises local end-to-end execution, asserting semantic identities and internal consistency while REPORTING rather than asserting the complete artifact root. Reproducibility of producer binaries, if ever wanted, is its own gate with an explicitly identified build environment, and this protocol defines none.
